Hi Avery / Jonas,

We're starting the renewal packet for Orion Payments (contract renewal in May). Our security team needs to confirm Redwood's recertification timeline and an evidence plan for SOC 2 before we proceed with the procurement queue. Specifically:

- Confirmation that Redwood will have an active SOC 2 report covering the renewal window (May 2028).
- A candidate list of evidence artifacts we can expect to receive (logs, control narratives, key test evidence) and an estimated delivery cadence.
- Whether Redwood can extend log retention for our account to 24 months (current default is 12 months) and a price or seat/capacity implication for that change.

We're also open to an evidence dry-run (small subset) if that helps speed the attestation review. Raj from procurement is copied for contract timing.

Can you outline a proposed handoff plan and who from Redwood will coordinate the upload/transfer?

Thanks,
Sofia

Orion Payments

Hi Sofia — thanks for the clear ask. High-level plan below; I copied Marissa (Compliance) and Jonas (Sales lead) to coordinate timing and seat/retention impact.

1) SOC 2 status: Redwood is on a March 2028 recert cycle; we will have an updated SOC 2 report available by 2028-04-20. We'll provide the report and a controls snapshot as part of the renewal packet.

2) Evidence manifest & cadence: attached is a draft manifest (redwood_soc2_evidence_manifest_v2.xlsx) that lists artifacts we can deliver. Short version:
  - System configuration snapshots and control narratives: T+5 business days after request
  - Sampled event logs (redacted where required): T+10 business days for initial batch; subsequent batches on weekly cadence until sampling complete
  - Policy docs and org attestations: immediate (within 48 hours)

3) Log retention request: extending to 24 months for Orion is feasible. There are two ways we can enable this: (a) account-level retention extension — minimal cost but requires a 3-month lead to resize storage buckets, or (b) dedicated retention tier (recommended for high-volume clients) — involves a capacity uplift and a recurring uplift fee. Jonas, can you confirm commercial options?

4) Evidence dry-run: happy to run a small POC exchange for 1 week of logs + 3 control artifacts. Marissa will run the evidence checklist and confirm redaction guidelines.

Next steps: Jonas to scope commercial delta; Marissa to share the evidence playbook and redaction checklist by EOD tomorrow; I'll schedule a 30-min kickoff with your security and procurement teams.

Best,
Avery Johnson
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
(Attachment: redwood_soc2_evidence_manifest_v2.xlsx)

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>

Thanks — quick commercial note from my side. Two options for retention:

Option A (account extension): +$1,200/month — preserves data in our standard object store with 24-month lifecycle. No infra migration required but retention is applied bucket-wise across your account. Lead time: ~3 weeks.

Option B (dedicated long-term retention tier): +$4,500/month (recommended if your monthly ingest > 2TB) — moves logs to compressed cold tier with dedicated storage and separate export SLAs. Lead time: ~6 weeks and requires a brief onboarding change window.

If Orion wants the dedicated tier, we'll include the uplift in the renewal quote and propose a phased migration so production isn't impacted. I'll follow up with a redlined quote once Sofia confirms expected ingest.

Also tagging Marissa: please confirm whether the weekly sampled logs cadence works for attest sampling, and flag any additional controls the auditor usually requests beyond our manifest.

-Jonas
Head of Sales, East Coast

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Sofia K. <sofia.k@orionpayments.com>, avery_johnson@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com
Date: 2028-03-03T14:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal + SOC 2 re-attestation — evidence cadence and log window

Hi Sofia — gratitude for the detail. Some practical notes from Compliance & Evidence Ops: 

- I've attached the log retention matrix (log_retention_matrix.csv) and a short proof-of-controls snapshot (proof_of_controls_snapshot.pdf). These show typical retention behavior per log type and examples of sanitized samples we can produce.

- On redaction: we will remove PII fields by default for shared samples and provide hashing guidance so auditors can recompute where necessary. If you need raw logs (no redaction) we will need an MOU and a separate secure transfer with access controls.

- Weekly sampling cadence is fine for initial attestation. For the dry-run, we propose: 1 week of application logs + 2 system snapshots + control evidence file. After the dry-run, we'll collect auditor feedback and iterate.

- For evidence delivery we use a secure S3 transfer with presigned URLs and optional transfer via an SFTP gateway. Expected delivery SLA for the first bundle: 7 business days after kickoff.

I'll join the kickoff. Please propose times — we prefer mornings.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Director, Compliance & Controls
Redwood Inference
(Attachments: log_retention_matrix.csv, proof_of_controls_snapshot.pdf)

Appreciate the quick turnaround.
